citation: Breslow and Day (1980), Statistical Methods in Cancer Research, vol 1, table 4.17. Ille-et-Vilaine, France case-control study; 200 cases and 775 controls in 88 age/alcohol/tobacco strata.
caveat: Case-control sample counts, not a representative cohort. Case share is a sample composition statistic; it is not incidence, population risk or a causal alcohol effect.
preset_policy: No runtime mappings or presets; ordinary field approval and metric creation performed through the UI.
